apps.versionDescription:
YouTube 21.29.3 | YTKACE_21.29.3_0.6.7

### Latest Release, ENJOY!!

> #### A new free and [open-source](https://github.com/Epic0001/YTKACE) YouTube enhancer for iOS with downloads, SponsorBlock, player controls, and interface customization.

> What’s new:
> • Expanded Fix Playback & Account Recovery support
> • Improved compatibility with YouTube 21.29.3
> Fixed:
> • Fixed Shorts tab crashes on certain devices and LiveContainer
> • Fixed Shorts shelf gaps and overlapping videos
> • Fixed several playback hook signatures
> • Improved OLED theme switching and navigation icon updates
> • Improved hidden tab-label alignment and stability
